title: Effects of Zn Fertilization on Hordein Transcripts at Early Developmental Stage of Barley Grain and Correlation with Increased Zn Concentration in the Mature Grain
authors: Uddin MN, Kaczmarczyk A, Vincze E
note: This paper studies BARLEY, not wheat. Three Zn treatments: Low (basic nutrient only), Medium (0.25 mM ZnSO4 soil + 1 mM foliar), High (1 mM ZnSO4 soil + 10 mM foliar). Grain Zn from Table 1.
